title: Splitwise: Efficient generative LLM inference using phase splitting
authors: Pratyush Patel; Esha Choukse; Chaojie Zhang; Aashaka Shah; Íñigo Goiri; Saeed Maleki; Ricardo Bianchini

problem_statement.en: Generative LLM inference consists of a compute-intensive prompt computation phase and a memory-intensive token generation phase, leading to resource underutilization when both phases are run on the same machine. This results in inefficient GPU usage and high costs for cloud service providers.
problem_statement.zh: 生成式 LLM inference 由計算密集的 prompt 計算階段與記憶體密集的 token 生成階段組成，在同一機器上共同運行時資源利用率低落，導致 GPU 使用效率不佳並推高雲端服務商的成本。

key_innovation.en: Splitwise, a deployment and scheduling technique that decouples the prompt computation and token generation phases onto separate machines, enabling phase-specific hardware optimization and efficient KV-cache transfer.
key_innovation.zh: Splitwise 是一種部署與排程技術，將 prompt 計算與 token 生成階段解耦合至獨立機器，從而實現各階段的針對性硬體優化與高效的 KV cache 傳輸。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.4x higher throughput at 20% lower cost, or 2.35x more throughput under the same power and cost budgets.
key_improvements.zh: 在成本降低 20% 的前提下 throughput 最高提升 1.4x；或在相同功耗與成本預算下 throughput 可達 2.35x。

traffic_pattern: Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, Continuous Batching
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; KV-transfer sized empirically — 1.13 GB OPT-66B prompt at 90 Gbps for 10 req/s)

scope_assumptions.en: Phase characterization assumes prompt-token-count and generation-token-count distributions taken from Azure production traces; KV-cache transfer modeled as layer-wise async overlap with prefill compute over InfiniBand; heterogeneous-cluster recipes (H100 prefill + A100 decode) require manual provisioning, not auto-derived from the model.
scope_assumptions.zh: Phase characterization 假設 prompt token 數與生成 token 數分布取自 Azure 生產流量；KV cache 傳輸建模為以 InfiniBand 進行的 layer-wise 非同步傳輸，與 prefill compute 重疊；異質叢集配方（H100 prefill + A100 decode）需手動 provisioning，無法由模型自動推導。
